purpose: give the four-system question-answering comparison with exact values
takeaway: ASMOS-memory scores below No-Memory and RAG on static question answering.
uncertainty_shown: none in the table; paired intervals are in the text
non_conclusions: one run of 24 items; no p-values; metric definitions undocumented
caption: In a single run of static question answering, ASMOS-memory scores below both No-Memory and RAG on both metrics; ASMOS combined with RAG is close to RAG on exact match but far below it on token-F1, and its exact match exceeds its token-F1, which standard definitions of the two metrics do not allow.
